comingLast.roast: level pegging with Howard - the countback rules are being googled at the bar
5 points to safety - his back nine just became the main event
6 points buys freedom - Boney is pricing it higher by the minute
averaging 1.3 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
still out there on 22 - the clubhouse is doing his maths for him
all square with Boney at the bottom - somebody has to blink (or wipe)
3 clear and finished - now a full-time Boney supporter
